verdict.rationale: Algolia ships the InstantSearch UI libraries (vanilla JS and React) for building live search interfaces, typo tolerance designed for users 'while typing', and Distributed Search Network routing to the nearest servers. Independent users corroborate the experience: teams chose it 'mainly because of speed', call it 'blazing fast', praise DocSearch's instant results, and run it on live-search UIs. One report of the HN search being occasionally slow tempers confidence but does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: first-party documentation stating millisecond latency figures, explicit docs on per-keystroke query/refresh behavior.
